correctness.rationale: Adding the five printed continuous Caputo SIAQR fields cancels exactly, so total population is conserved. Equation (5.22) uses the recovered state R in its first g5 history term but the quarantine state Q in the two higher g5 differences, destroying the componentwise cancellation. For the exact invariant submodel I=A=Q=0, N=1, delta=omega=1/2 and gamma=1/2, R(t)=exp(t) erfc(sqrt(t)). An independent 50-digit replay gives the first fully affected m=2 population defect -0.492078936843788976989587439259416..., matching the inspected verifier. Replacing the two Q histories by the corresponding R histories restores exact cancellation.
